Maya (support): Hey team, escalated case from AcmeCorp — their Analytics view shows zero traffic when they select region=eu-west + multiple model versions. They say toggling versions makes data reappear. Repro steps below.

Jun (eng-frontend): Assigning to frontend to start, but tagging runtime too since model/version logic might be involved.

Maya (support): Repro steps I got from customer:
1) Org has hits in eu-west and us-east.
2) Console -> Analytics -> Model: `redwood/fast-gen` -> Versions: `v2, v3` (both selected).
3) Region filter: `eu-west` only.
4) Charts show empty/zero for that interval.
5) If they switch Versions to `v3` only, metrics appear immediately.
6) They noticed this after yesterday's alias rollout where `v3` became default for some traffic.

Maya (support): Quick curl they used to check server-side:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?model=redwood%2Ffast-gen&versions=v2%2Cv3&region=eu-west&from=1680000000&to=1680003600"
```
returns empty buckets, while hitting with `versions=v3` returns data.

Jun (eng-frontend): I can repro locally with a seeded test org. Frontend is sending `region` as an array when multi-selects present (e.g. `region=[\"eu-west\"]`) but API gateway logs show aggregator receives `region` as an array and then drops it in downstream query generation. Suspect filter serialization mismatch between console client and metrics aggregator.

Sree (eng-runtime): Looking at aggregator logs for that query id — when multiple versions are present, aggregator merges per-version shards. There's a short-circuit: if ANY selected version has no shard mapping for a region, we treat region filter as not-applicable and fall back to global aggregation. That explains why selecting only v3 returns data (shards exist) but v2+v3 together returns empty for eu-west.

Olivia (product): So effectively the region filter becomes a no-op or incorrectly filters everything depending on the version set. That's bad UX, especially post-rollout. Severity from customer: blocking insights.

Jun (eng-frontend): Short-term mitigation ideas:
- Detect when versions selection will cause inconsistent shard mappings and show a banner + disable multiselect (bad UX).
- Or coerce client to request per-version region filters (no change server-side).
Long-term: change aggregator logic to apply region filter per-version and OR results rather than dropping filters.

Sree (eng-runtime): Agreed. Quick fix I'll try: change aggregator flag to not drop region when any version missing shards — instead return empty buckets for the missing ones and merge. That should make combined selection show data for versions that have it, and empty for the rest. PR incoming.

Maya (support): I've communicated workaround to customer: remove v2 from selection or include us-east as well. They aren't thrilled but okay to try.

deploy-bot: PR #4521 scheduled for canary deploy to `dev` cluster at 2026-03-18T08:30:00Z.

Jun (eng-frontend): Once runtime fix lands, I'll update client to always send `region` as CSV string for compatibility and add unit test for region/version permutations.

Olivia (product): Please add an item to the postmortem if rollout changed aliasing behavior that caused mismatched shard coverage. We should also notify any customers who used multi-version analytics in the last 48h.

Sree (eng-runtime): Opening PR and marking as sev-3. I'll post link here when ready.

Maya (support): Thanks — I'll follow up with AcmeCorp with estimated ETA and the temporary workaround. :thumbsup:
